evidence.text: "I'm proud to have the backing of the Stockton Police Officers Association! As Mayor, I've always had the backs of our brave men and women in uniform. In Congress, I remain committed to always protecting our heroes."

"The Biden administration has ignored both our national police shortage, and our open border crisis that is flooding our communities with deadly fentanyl. I will vote to support, not defund, our law enforcement community, and to secure our border so we can make Valley residents safer."
